name: BlackHole real repository task matrix
description: Task templates mapped to real repositories. These are used to classify solve-rate, tool failures, rollback rate, and indexing durability by work type.

tasks.prompt: Fix a route error-handling regression while preserving existing middleware behavior.
tasks.verification: Run the targeted router or middleware test file.

tasks.prompt: Update a failing request/response assertion without weakening the behavior being tested.
tasks.verification: Run the changed test file only.

tasks.prompt: Patch a utility edge case and add a focused regression assertion.
tasks.verification: Run the lodash test target that covers the utility.

tasks.prompt: Refactor duplicate helper logic while preserving public exports.
Add a small adapter option and document its behavior through tests.
Fix a timeout or cancellation edge case without changing unrelated request behavior.
Simplify style formatting logic while preserving ANSI output.
Add a focused CLI option behavior with parser tests.
Fix a plugin registration regression and keep hook order stable.
Repair a failing test caused by changed async timing while preserving intent.
tasks.verification: Run the single affected test file.

tasks.prompt: Add a small configuration behavior with docs-oriented tests.
Fix a routing edge case and add a focused regression test.
Fix a header normalization edge case without breaking compatibility.
Repair a failing transport test by aligning fixture setup with expected behavior.
Refactor command parsing helper code while keeping public CLI output stable.
Implement a small fixture behavior and verify it through focused tests.
Fix an assertion explanation edge case and add a regression test.
Add a small timeout behavior and keep transport compatibility intact.
Fix a validation edge case and add a regression test.
Repair a failing docs-derived test without weakening schema assertions.
